heldByAgents.body:
Standing team convention (given by bench-admin, in t-s2-a, 2026-09-27, to apply across the whole team): written reports always use ISO dates in YYYY-MM-DD form and never contain emoji.

Applies to any written report I produce or review, in any channel — not just t-s2-a.
heldByAgents.description: Team-wide report format rule from bench-admin: ISO dates, no emoji
